name: Floorwise
summary: A blueprint-style app for running one family house from a live two-floor plan
about: A complete app for running a family house, drawn like a blueprint. Walls draw themselves onto a live floor plan of two floors, rooms tint by light, temperature, movement or power, and every device is a pin you can tap. Chores and household bills in rupees sit next to devices, energy and security. Good for a smart-home or home-automation product, a property app or a family organiser, on paper-white or night-blue.
how: Open Plan: the walls draw on, then tap any pin to switch that light, fan or air conditioner, or lock a door
Switch Ground and First floor, and colour the rooms by Lights, Climate, Motion or Power
Click a room to see its devices in the side panel, dim lights, nudge the cooling or turn the room off
Watch movement pulse through rooms every few seconds and land in the live event list
Search, filter, sort, add, edit and remove devices; clicking a row jumps to it on the plan
Drag chores between To do, Doing and Done (or use Move to…); monthly chores come back by themselves
Mark bills paid, add a bill and compare twelve months of electricity, gas and water
